name: Gwen of the Worm

intro.text: Fifty years I've walked out to the Worm on the tide, cariad. I've seen it breathe. Before I let you go out to the Outer Head, show me you can handle what's out there.

win: Duw, duw. You'll do. The Outer Head's yours.
after: Listen at the blowhole when the swell's up. If something answers, be polite.
